serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Oh, he sent me a message while I was talking with that crazy bastard.
Little_Richard: Ok, telling him to fuck off is a bad idea. He might seek revenge on you. Just ignore him.
…
AbusedTenant: It’s kinda too late for that…
Little_Richard: Oh well. It’s not like he can hurt you or anything
AbusedTenant: He told me he knows where I live.
Little_Richard:  Don’t worry, he’s probably bullshitting
AbusedTenant: I think he was telling the truth, he left me a phone near where I live.
Little_Richard: Are you kidding me?! Why didn’t you tell me sooner?!
AbusedTenant: I was kind of nervous, you know?! 
Little_Richard: Sorry, it’s also my fault since it was me who told you to tell him to fuck off…
Little_Richard: For now just throw out the phone he contacted you with. I got a message from the Admin, he’s trying to figure out what’s going on.
AbusedTenant: You told him? What if he’s the one who wanted the gun?
Little_Richard: I know him for a long time, I trust him! 
Maybe it was a bad idea to ask Richard for help… 
Little_Richard: Go home for now and close the door. I will get the gun and talk with the Admin.
Little_Richard: In the meantime, send me every email you received from the guy who was giving you missions.
AbusedTenant: Alright…
